scope: Linux installation prefix (//:hirsel-toolchain): every shipped file is classified by `files`. Crate inventories are link inputs (Rust and bundled C/assembly, before dead-code elimination) of the compiler and the runtime archive; build scripts and proc-macro executables are build tools, not linked libraries. Native libraries are the llvm-23.lock pins, with the notices of the source tree they are built from and of the C and C++ runtimes they link statically. Upstream library notices can conservatively cover other targets.

runtime/*/*/libhirsel_core_rt.a.contents: the runtime archive a program links, per target

core-packages/*.contents: the core and std package images (Hirsel sources and their checked and compiled products)

hirsel.profdata.contents: the profile a PGO build of the compiler used (PGO builds only)

engine_llvm.static_note: Linked by the pinned clang and lld against the build host's glibc and GCC; the startup objects, libgcc and libc_nonshared parts linked into it are covered conservatively by both runtimes' texts. libz, libstdc++, libm, libgcc_s and libc are loaded from the host.

static_lld.static_note: A static PIE: it contains the build host's glibc (libc.a, libm.a; LGPL-2.1-or-later) and libstdc++, libgcc and libgcc_eh (GPL-3.0-or-later with the GCC Runtime Library Exception).

native_text_rule: From the locked source archive (source_url, source_sha256): each component's licenses, every file under its source_dirs named LICENSE/COPYING/COPYRIGHT/NOTICE, and every text file there that contains 'copyright', outside test, unittests, docs and utils directories.

glibc.source: The corresponding source is Ubuntu's glibc 2.39-0ubuntu8.12 source package. The rest of each component is built from the locked LLVM source archive by its build script (tools/native-toolchain/build-static-lld with static-lld-elf-only.patch, or build-libllvm), so a recipient can rebuild and relink it against a modified glibc.

gcc.source: The corresponding source is Ubuntu's gcc-13 13.3.0-6ubuntu2~24.04.1 source package; the GCC Runtime Library Exception (in the copyright file) applies.

external.component: Host loader, libc, libm, libgcc_s, libstdc++ and libz (the DT_NEEDED libraries of hirsel and lib/libLLVM.so.23.1)
external.status: System dependencies, not copied into the installation.
